Positive social impact will occur through increasing the general interest in and awareness of natural processes and ecological problems. An enhanced public awareness of these issues may be expected to result in increased appreciation of natural recreational activities and better informed public participation in decision making processes relating to land use and resource development planning.
Down through history, certain species have become important symbols to man in various societies. Symbols lose their meaning if the animal species becomes extinct. Disappearance of the bald eagle would certainly tarnish the meaning of the symbol of the American republic. Impact of the program on people would be perpetuation of the meaning of symbols involving animals throughout the world.
Research impact: Experience in the scientific field has shown that the wild strain of certain species of animals have certain characteristics superior to experimental animals that man has developed himself. Who could have predicted the value of the fruit fly in development of the science of genetics? Horticulturists still use wild stock in the production of many varities of plants useful to man. Species of salamanders are very useful in embryological research applicable over the entire animal kingdom. Blood of the depleted paddle fish has become useful in recent years in experiments to find controls for the rejection mechanisms in human organ transplants. Preservation of all species for the discovery of such a research value in a few can constitute a considerable impact to be recognized sometime in the future.
